description:
Add a dedicated shortcut for renaming the current tmux window, alongside the existing pane and session rename follow-ups. Keep the shortcut model consistent with the current tmux naming workflow so pane/window/session can be renamed without leaving the keyboard. Acceptance: the current window can be renamed from normal tmux focus, and the rename flow does not interfere with pane or session renaming.

Plan:
- Reuse the existing rename popup flow instead of introducing a separate prompt.
- Make sure the shortcut works from normal tmux focus and from the sidebar.
- Keep the rename command no-op if the target name is unchanged.
- Validate that session and pane rename paths keep working after the window rename shortcut is added.
title: Add tmux window rename shortcut
